fusions.name: Drawing Cut
fusions.desc: A short cut that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Bitter Flick
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that deals 5 poison damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 4 seconds, lowering the damage it deals.

fusions.name: Bloodletting
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Aftertaste
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions lifts, your physical damage rises 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 8% poison resistance.
